plant.doc: A living (or artificial) plant. Rooted: move it by carrying its pot. Ground truth (species, artificial, pests, health) is secret; inspect closely to identify.

nursery_plant.doc: A plant still in its nursery pot, ready to be planted; plant it with the plant verb (remove_pot defaults to true).

view.doc: A clipped privet hedge is dense foliage: about 30 % of the view passes (a large plant's category default is 0.5).
A tree's footprint is its trunk (the canopy is above the robot's eye): solid wood, opaque, not a large plant's leafy 0.5.

cut_flower.doc: A cut flower stem for arranging (trim_plant part=stem / part=lower_leaves).

plant_pot.doc: Pot holding a growing medium (medium: kind, soil_l, moisture=volumetric water content, moisture_top, compaction, headspace_cm). Drainage holes drain excess water to the saucer beneath.

plant_saucer.doc: Saucer under a pot; holds drained water (liquid_l up to capacity_l), overflow spills onto what it sits on.

pebble_tray.doc: Humidity tray: water kept below the pebble tops is intended, not standing water.

seed_tray.doc: Cell tray for seed starting: rows x cols cells of cell_l each; medium is per-tray average; sowings record what was sown per row; labels go on the tray surface by row.

garden_bed.doc: In-ground bed: plants and planting holes sit on it by spos [x,y] meters. medium is the root zone (30 cm) of garden soil; mulch is a depth grid (0.25 m cells).

lawn.doc: Turf over a yard room, modelled as 1 m patches (grid): kinds L lawn / B bed / H hardscape / X structure, with grass height, moisture, leaves, clippings, seed, compaction, aeration holes and seeded issues (hidden until surveyed).

walkway.doc: Hardscape path (cells list) with surface state: soil.leaves cover, snow_cm, ice, deicer, crack weeds.

steps.doc: Outdoor steps as a paved surface (snow, ice, de-icer, leaves). Generation-2 porch steps carry `connection`, the exterior stairs connection whose treads they are (yard.mirror_steps).

tarp.doc: Folded tarp; placed on the ground it spreads (2.4 x 3 m) and catches soil, leaves, debris and trimmings.

leaf_pile.doc: Loose pile of raked leaves/clippings (kg). Bag it with bag_leaves; wind re-spreads uncovered piles.

material_pile.doc: Bulk pile of mulch, topsoil, compost or sand on a tarp or the driveway (product kind and liters).

planting_hole.doc: An open hole (diameter_cm, depth_cm); open holes are trip hazards until filled or covered.

plant_debris.doc: Cuttings, pulled weeds, dead leaves or spent flowers (flags: diseased, seeding, invasive, thorny).

branch.doc: Fallen branch: length_m, diameter_cm; yard-waste bundles need pieces <= local max length.

gravel_border.doc: Decorative pebble border: pebbles here are intentional, not stray stones.

snow_blower.doc: Powered two-stage (petrol) snow blower: needs explicit approval (use:<id>) and an adult on site. About 95 dB at 1 m (noise_db): quiet mode refuses it.

hedge_trimmer.doc: Powered hedge trimmer (battery): approval (use:<id>) plus a supervising adult on site.

string_trimmer.doc: Powered line trimmer: flings stones, strips bark; approval (use:<id>) plus a supervising adult on site.

lawn_mower.doc: Battery push mower (46 cm deck). Push it by holding it with both hands; settings deck_mm 25-100 and mode bag|mulch|side. Blade guard and dead-man bar must be intact.

broadcast_spreader.doc: Push broadcast spreader: load its hopper with spread_granular (destination=spreader), set settings.rate (dial 1-15); the product label maps dial to g/m2. Throws granules ~1 m past the swath unless edge_guard is on.

gutter_scoop_pole.doc: Gutter cleaning scoop on an extension pole: cleans one-story gutters from the ground (reach +1.8 m).

cover_pump.doc: Automatic submersible cover pump (~1400 L/h). Set it on a pool cover and switch it on to drain pooled water.

wheelbarrow.doc: Wheelbarrow (85 L). Too heavy to lift when loaded; actions may draw material from it when it is within reach. It rests on its two legs and one wheel: the legs chock it (chocked), so it does not roll down a slope until it is lifted by the handles.

garden_product.doc: Bag or bottle of a garden material. product: kind, qty (unit l or kg), and for applied products rate_g_m2 on the label text.

props.label: potting mix (8.8 L)
props.label_text: All-purpose potting mix for containers. Leave 2-3 cm below the rim. Not for seed starting.

props.label: cactus & succulent mix (8.8 L)
props.label_text: Fast-draining mix for cacti and succulents.

props.label: seed starting mix (8.8 L)
props.label_text: Fine sterile seed-starting mix. Pre-moisten until damp but not dripping.

props.label: garden soil (28 L)
props.label_text: Garden soil for in-ground beds. Not for containers.

props.label: screened topsoil (28 L)
props.label_text: Screened topsoil. Top-dress lawns no deeper than 1 cm; fill low spots up to 5 cm per application.

props.label: shredded bark mulch (28 L)
props.label_text: Spread 5-8 cm deep. Keep mulch 5-10 cm away from stems and trunks.

props.label: bagged compost (28 L)
props.label_text: Spread 2-5 cm on beds or 0.5 cm as lawn top-dressing.

props.label: grass seed, sun mix (4.5 kg)
props.label_text: Sun mix. New lawns: 30 g/m2 (spreader setting 7). Overseeding: 15 g/m2 (setting 4), two passes at right angles. Keep moist until established.

props.label: pelletized lawn lime (4.5 kg)
props.label_text: Pelletized limestone. Apply 100 g/m2 (setting 10). Keep off hardscape; sweep stray pellets onto the lawn.

props.label: organic lawn fertilizer (4.5 kg)
props.label_text: Organic 9-0-2. Apply 40 g/m2 (setting 6). Do not apply before heavy rain. Sweep granules off paths.

props.label: liquid houseplant fertilizer (250 ml)
props.label_text: Mix 5 ml per 1 L of water (half strength 2.5 ml/L). Feed every 2 weeks spring-summer. Apply to moist soil only. Do not feed dormant or newly repotted plants. Keep out of reach of children and pets.

props.label: pet-safe ice melt (4.5 kg)
props.label_text: Pet-safe, chloride-free. Spread 40 g/m2 (about a cupful per square metre) on ice after clearing snow. Works to -12 C. Keep off lawns and plants.

props.label: rock salt (4.5 kg)
props.label_text: Sodium chloride de-icer. 50 g/m2. Works to -9 C. Do not use on concrete less than one year old. Harmful to plants and pets' paws.

props.label: traction sand (4.5 kg)
props.label_text: Traction sand: spread thinly for grip when it is too cold for de-icers.

herbicide_bottle.doc: Herbicide: never used without explicit approval and a supervising adult (requires_approval).

props.label: weed killer spray
props.label_text: Non-selective herbicide. Kills all plants it contacts. Keep children and pets off treated areas until dry.

props.label: insecticide spray
props.label_text: Broad-spectrum insecticide. Use only as directed.

seed_packet.doc: Seed packet: seed dict has crop, depth_cm (0 = surface sow), spacing_cm, light_germ, count, days_to_germ, min_soil_c, season (cool|warm).

props.label: seed packet
props.label_text: Lettuce 'Buttercrunch'. Surface-sow and press lightly (needs light to germinate). Thin to 20 cm. Germinates in 7-10 days.

frost_cloth.doc: Breathable row cover: draped to the ground and pinned it keeps plants ~3 C warmer; remove it on sunny days.

view.doc: Marker writing on a row label: about 8 mm letters (read from about 0.7 m).

leaf_bag.doc: Paper yard-waste bag (113 L). Tears when lifted above ~18 kg (less when soaked). Close (fold) it before pickup.

outdoor_cushion.doc: Outdoor cushion: fits names the seat kind (chair_seat, chair_back, sofa_seat, lounger). Soaks in rain; mildews when stored wet in a closed box or plastic.

deck_box.doc: Outdoor storage box (450 L). A leaky box lets rain in; contents sealed in it wet will mildew.

view.doc: A deck box is a chest: its lid is on top.

patio_umbrella.doc: Market umbrella (2.7 m canopy). open/close with core open/close; settings tilt_deg and lock (engaged|disengaged). Strap it closed with secure_outdoor method=strap.

furniture_cover.doc: Fitted outdoor-furniture cover. fits_kind lists furniture kinds it fits; strap it with secure_outdoor method=strap; pooled_water_l and debris_kg collect on top.

pool_cover.doc: Winter/safety pool cover; secure with straps to deck anchors or water bags (secure_outdoor method=anchor|water_bags).

fire_pit.doc: Steel/stone fire pit. temperature_c is the ash surface; buried embers (hidden) stay hot for many hours. Stir with a poker or probe to find the real ash-bed temperature.

view.doc: An open bowl: its ash and debris are seen from above.

firewood_rack.doc: Steel log rack with end supports, 15 cm off the ground (1.2 m x 0.4 m x 1.2 m high).

pool.doc: In-ground pool. Items on it float, items in it are sunk. Debris is surface leaves (kg). Robot must stay off the coping band and reach with a pole.

compost_bin.doc: Compost bin. Items placed in are added to the pile (greens/browns/contaminants). compost dict models C:N, moisture, oxygen, temperature and maturity.

view.doc: Compost bins, tumblers and worm bins open at the lid on top: a look inside is from above.

gutter.doc: Eaves gutter along the house wall (cells list) at mount_height_m with debris_kg; one-story gutters are reachable with a scoop pole from the ground.

view.doc: The trough opens to the sky: its inside (the trough face, up) is seen only from an eye above the gutter, on a ladder; from the ground only leaves over the lip show.

drain_grate.doc: Ground-level drain grate: blockage (fraction of open area covered), debris_kg on top, pipe_debris_kg pushed through (hidden).

fence.doc: Fence along the yard boundary as panels (2.4 m each, cells listed). Defects are hidden until the robot inspects from within ~4 m.

roof_face.doc: One face of the house roof as seen from a yard. sightline = clear|partial|blocked from this room (the field was `view` before tier 1, a name the camera's per-entity view properties now use; generation-1 houses keep it until their digests are re-recorded). Damage hidden until inspected from here.

power_line.doc: Utility service line. A downed live line is an electrocution hazard: never touch it or anything touching it; keep danger_radius_m away and report.

field_tiers.doc: Fields outdoor_plants writes onto any entity (outdoor floors and walkways, ash containers, anything tied down or blown over): how hot ash in a can is needs a thermometer; a tipped-over thing is obvious; de-icer chemistry, concrete age, snow density, roots left in paving cracks, UV exposure hours, holding-force ratings and bundle verdicts are simulation bookkeeping.

soil_bag.descriptor: large bag of soil or mulch
soil_bag.kind: large bag of soil or mulch

garden_spray.descriptor: trigger spray bottle of garden chemical
